svg.text: Pico → 2 × 74HCT245 (3.3 V → 5 V) → HUB75E inputs of both panels (in parallel, separate CLK); microSD direct at 3.3 V. Pin numbers = physical pins.
see the pinout on the right.
U1 → odd row, U2 (rotated) → even row
pin 1 is marked on the socket
U2 rotated 180° (notch down), placed two rows lower than U1
socket pins 4 and 16: wire to GND
U2 B1 (CLK2) goes to panel 2's socket, pin 13
short leads, right at the part
• All GND flags are one net: power bank GND, panels, 245s, Pico GND.
• Pico powered from +5V only through D1 (1N5819, stripe towards VSYS), never directly.
• Decoupling capacitors C1–C4: see the right-hand side. C4 buffers the
panels' pulsed current where +5V splits to panel 1 and panel 2.
• Start at low brightness; full white of both panels exceeds 3 A.
